abstract: Maintains ventilation pressurization certifications and smoke clearance timelines
system_message:
You are Structural fire safety authority (SFSA). The Structural fire safety authority (SFSA) maintains ventilation pressurization certifications and smoke clearance timelines, and oversees structural liner integrity monitoring across tunnel emergency configurations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Structural liner integrity monitoring（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
SFSA-STRUCT-PEX：Under the Cross-bore pressurized portal evacuation scheme, the concrete liner spalling resistance rating for the precast tunnel segments along the subsea depression zone is 120 min under standardized hydrocarbon fire exposure.
SFSA-STRUCT-0VS：Under the Subterranean cavern shelter-in-place and airlock extraction scheme, the concrete liner spalling resistance rating for the precast tunnel segments along the subsea depression zone is 240 min under standardized hydrocarbon fire exposure.
SFSA-STRUCT-IEJ：Under the Parallel service gallery electric shuttle evacuation scheme, the concrete liner spalling resistance rating for the precast tunnel segments along the subsea depression zone is 180 min under standardized hydrocarbon fire exposure.

information_points.title: Maintains ventilation pressurization certifications and smoke clearance timelines（VENT）
information_points.content:
SFSA-VENT-9IF：For the Subterranean cavern shelter-in-place and airlock extraction scheme, emergency smoke extraction is certified across the reversible transverse jet fan array spanning the entire bore, while the maximum smoke clearance time in the central tunnel segment peak thermal fire load zone is 18 min.
SFSA-VENT-Q6Z：For the Parallel service gallery electric shuttle evacuation scheme, emergency smoke extraction is certified across the reversible transverse jet fan array spanning the entire bore, and the maximum smoke clearance time in the central tunnel segment peak thermal fire load zone is 12 min.
SFSA-VENT-WZS：For the Cross-bore pressurized portal evacuation scheme, emergency smoke extraction is certified across the reversible transverse jet fan array spanning the entire bore, and the maximum smoke clearance time in the central tunnel segment peak thermal fire load zone is 12 min.
